function.name: update_content
function.description: Update content in the specified content folder; data must comply with the content type schema.

dataJson.description: The data that needs to be modified, provided as a static JSON string; must comply with the schema returned by get_content_schema, e.g. { 'field1': 'value', ... }.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
